features.name: GP Configuration Page
features.description: New page providing more flexibility in choosing what data to migrate from GP to Business Central, replacing the all-or-nothing approach of the migration setup wizard.

features.name: Module-Level Selection in Migration
features.description: Ability to choose which modules to bring over from GP, such as GL, AP, AR, or Bank, rather than migrating all modules together.
caveats: Requires selection in GP configuration page

features.name: Inactive Checkbook and Bank Account Filtering
features.description: New option to exclude inactive checkbooks and bank accounts from migration, allowing customers to avoid bringing old accounts to Business Central.

features.name: Unreconciled Bank Transaction Migration
features.description: Capability to migrate unreconciled bank transactions, eliminating the requirement to reconcile bank accounts before migration.

features.name: Fiscal Period Information Migration
features.description: Automatic migration of fiscal period setup from GP to Business Central accounting periods, eliminating manual reconfiguration.

features.name: Vendor Bank Account Information Migration
features.description: Option to automatically migrate bank account information associated with vendors from GP to Business Central.

features.name: Classes to Posting Groups Conversion
features.description: Ability to migrate GP classes for customers, items, and vendors as posting groups in Business Central with proper assignments.
caveats: Posting groups created based on GP classes

features.name: GL Year Limitation for Migration
features.description: New option to limit the number of GL years migrated by specifying a starting year, with automatic creation of beginning balances.
caveats: Automatically creates beginning balances for the starting year

features.name: Master Data Only Migration Option
features.description: Ability to select individual modules to bring only master data records without transaction information.

features.name: Discontinued Items Filtering
features.description: New option to exclude discontinued or inactive items from migration during the GP to Business Central process.

features.name: Unique GL Summary Document Numbering
features.description: Enhancement that increments document numbers for individual GL summary records during migration to prevent reconciliation issues when reversing specific transactions.
caveats: Addresses reconciliation and transaction reversal challenges

features.name: Global Dimensions Configuration
features.description: Setup of global dimensions where GP segments are mapped to Business Central dimensions, with main account segment as natural account and two segments as global dimensions.
caveats: Segments beyond two become shortcut dimensions
Configuration per company for different dimension structures

features.name: Company-Level Migration Tweaks
features.description: Ability to override global migration settings at the individual company level when migrating multiple companies with different requirements.
caveats: Correlated options automatically unmark if related option is deselected
